title: Meet El Josto
details: One day she saw a movie about a hostel in Bratislava and set out to repeat the sex tour of the main characters. Unfortunately, her knowledge of the English language does not save her in the backwoods of Eastern Europe, and she got lost. When she meets a friendly and welcoming man, she decides that he will take her to the local hostel. However, she did not hear at all that it was about the most disgusting criminal of this town, nicknamed El Josto...
